cases.prompt: A colleague on the payments team opened #204 to rework the retry logic and asked me to take a look, so go through it and draft what I should say before anything gets submitted.
Sam asked me to look over his changes at https://github.com/example-org/example-app/pull/58, what would you flag before I sign off on it?
Go through the contractor's open merge request number 76 and tell me what to push back on, then leave the notes on GitHub once I've okayed them.
Before I approve #412 from the platform team, check whether it follows our AGENTS.md conventions and the patterns in the surrounding code.
Look over my uncommitted changes for bugs before I commit them.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: checking your own local changes belongs to the review skill.

cases.prompt: Copilot left eleven comments on my PR #90, work through them and fix the ones that are real.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: addressing feedback on your own PR belongs to the pr-feedback skill.

cases.prompt: I've pushed fixes for the reviewer's notes on my PR #77, so reply to each thread and mark them resolved.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: replying to and resolving threads after a push belongs to the pr-resolve skill.
